features.text: Extra-Large Capacity
Large 7.4 cu. ft. capacity easily handles large loads like bedding and towels.
18-Minute Fast Dry
Quickly dry items you need in a hurry with the 18-minute fast-dry cycle.
10 Dry Cycles
Ten dry cycles let you customize to the load and fabric, including delicates and allergen.
Wrinkle Care Option
Using heat and additional tumbling, the wrinkle care option prevents wrinkles and keeps clothes looking fresh.
SENSORDRY
Moisture detection automatically adjusts dry time, eliminating damp spots and guesswork.
Energy Star® Certified
Save energy and money on your monthly bill with our ESTAR® rated dryer.
Effortless Controls
Sleek, thoughtfully designed controls simplify operation.
Extra Tumble Option
Keeps clothes gently tumbling until you’re ready to unload, to help reduce wrinkles.
Reversible Door
Reversible door ensures easy installation and use no matter your laundry setup.
2-Year Limited Warranty
Built for long-term reliability, get peace of mind and an extra year of coverage when you register your product.
DryBoost Option
Adds extra drying power to tackle heavier loads and hard-to-dry items, so items fully dry the first time.
Favorite Cycle
Save your two most-used cycles for easy, one-touch access.
Allergen Cycle
Removes common allergens from fabrics for a deeper, more hygienic clean.
Interior Light
Easily see every item in the drum so nothing gets left behind.
